description: As compliant, but set-leverage is refused because of the open position with retCode 110013, which the official v5 error table reads: cannot set leverage due to risk limit level (#3005).

POST /v5/position/set-leverage.note: No recorded refusal exists. 110013 and its message come from the official v5 error table (page dated 2026-10-14, #2893 S15; #3005); mapping.py maps it to risk_limit_tier. The pack answered 110044 before, which that table reads 'Available margin is insufficient.' (an insufficient-margin reject). The message is the table's description, not a recorded reply.

expected.outcome: 502 exchange_error carrying the exchange code and message; the UI shows the exact reason (code in details) and the slider returns to the previous leverage.
